rapport_notes: Handled a price-conscious customer's negotiation attempt calmly and without getting defensive.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "may I just ask do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer within this call?" -- asked right after the quid pro quo, before any logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: "No, so, so, yeah... you said that you are going to provide me with the code, right?" -- no concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments" -- pay-less-if-faster concept covered, but no self-prep tip or window framing.

top_strength: Held firm and professional on pricing when the customer pushed for a discount for not needing a truck, without souring the interaction.
coaching_note: Never gave a verbal estimate/anchor on the call at all (deferred entirely to the emailed quote) -- give a ballpark range live so the estimate lands while rapport is warm, before the customer goes to review it alone.
